_source: Wolfram LLMGraph CorrectWorkflow example - error detection and correction pipeline
_description: Decide if input has errors -> Review (if errors) -> Rewrite (if reviewed) -> Final output

nodes.Decide:
Decide if the following contains errors. Respond with either 'Correct' or 'Errors':

`Input`

Review.prompt:
List any errors in the following:

`Input`

Rewrite.prompt:
Rewrite the following text to fix any issues specified in the critique:

=== Text ===
`Input`

=== Critique ===
`Review`
Rewrite.test: lambda Review: isinstance(Review, str) and len(Review) > 0

Final.fn:
lambda Rewrite, Input: f'Incorrect input:
{Input}
has been rewritten as:
{Rewrite}' if isinstance(Rewrite, str) and len(Rewrite) > 0 else str(Input)
